usedFor: Jira Software Cloud holds issues and Sangam CRM holds sales opportunities, so “New Issue (Via JQL)” can run “Create Opportunity”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Issue (Via JQL)” in Jira Software Cloud, then “Create Opportunity” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A JQL filter picks the issues that matter, and each one becomes a Sangam CRM opportunity.

watchOut: “New Issue (Via JQL)” in Jira Software Cloud is polling, so the opportunity appears after a scheduled check.
